amendment.reason: Correcting the provenance description of analytical qualification, binding its implementation-driving requirements to the policy and ensuring that any authorized point contrasts use only explicitly approved discrete horizons. Candidate construction and specification selection remain outcome-blind, while downstream qualification uses outcome-dependent grouped-validation results under an explicitly result-informed exploratory rule.

status_definitions.missing_horizon: The required horizon value is missing.
status_definitions.nonpositive_horizon: The required horizon value is less than or equal to the configured exclusive minimum.
status_definitions.missing_outcome: The required outcome value is missing.
status_definitions.cohort_ineligible: The required cohort eligibility field is not exactly true.
status_definitions.incomplete_cumulative_fec: The cumulative FEC horizon is requested and cumulative_fec_observation_complete is not exactly true.
status_definitions.included: The record satisfies every candidate observation requirement.

baseline_adjustment.rationale: No model-specific baseline adjustment is authorized by the analytical scope.

encoding.hierarchy_definition: Every selected interaction term requires each exact lower-order encoded component to be authorized and selected in the same candidate.

longitudinal_structure.minimum_repeated_cells_for_random_interc: At least two independently replicated groups with within-group horizon replication are required to distinguish a random-intercept component from purely observation-level variation.
longitudinal_structure.differential_trajectory_rationale: A condition-specific horizon trajectory requires horizon variation and independently replicated within-cell change in every represented condition.
longitudinal_structure.common_trajectory_rationale: A longitudinal trajectory claim requires independently replicated within-cell horizon variation.

trajectory_summaries.summary_observation_support_rule: An observation is included when its cell belongs to the support region and its horizon satisfies that region's lower and upper boundary rules.

reporting.analysis_registration_rationale: This version preserves outcome-blind candidate construction and specification selection while applying result-informed analytical qualification based on grouped predictive benchmarking and complete diagnostic availability. It also separates optimizer convergence from warning diagnostics, uses scale-aware numerical random-effect checks and requires upstream discrete-horizon authorization for point contrasts. Analyses governed by this version are exploratory rather than confirmatory.
